requirements.description: Every ticket user ID resolves through the supplied identity table; unknown or blank identities block.
NEW maps to open, WAITING to pending and DONE to closed; unknown states block.
Restore the exact pre-run target snapshot in memory without mutating the source or snapshot.

steps.action: Obtain separate cutover authorization and support acceptance; stop while either is missing.
Operator freezes writes only within the approved window.
Operator captures and verifies source and target snapshots; changed identities require fresh evidence.
Run exact-revision acceptance tests and reconciliation against isolated copies; stop on any unmapped value.
Only the authorized operator may apply the bounded batch and switch routing after every gate clears.
Verify counts, identities, status mappings and error rates; apply rollback on any mismatch.
Request the named support owner's acknowledgement with results, limitations and escalation contacts.

rollback.trigger: Any unmapped identity/status, count mismatch, failed acceptance test or error rate above 1%.
steps: Stop routing and pause writes under operator authority.
Restore the verified pre-cutover target snapshot and prior adapter/routing.
Reconcile restored counts and sample IDs before asking the owner to resume service.

support.escalation: Neil Prakash for cutover; Dana Ruiz for mapping; Alex Rivera for adapter.
support.knownLimits: Synthetic local assertions only; live permissions, load, retention, write recovery and staffing are unverified.
